predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Aarhus vs AC Horsens: Expected Goals, Lineup Vulnerabilities & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Aarhus's home fortress and defensive stability will offset European fatigue and key absences to secure a result against AC Horsens' road-fragile setup.

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Aarhus rely on home stability against Horsens amid European fatigue and attacking absences.

spf.comment: Covers Aarhus's 83.3% home unbeaten record and defensive structure while respecting Horsens's counter-attacking danger against a fatigued host.

over_under.comment: Aarhus is missing key goal contributors Serra and Arnstad on short rest, curbing open-play scoring against a Horsens team that struggled away at Viborg.

score.comment: The 1:1 stalemate represents the primary probabilistic convergence, with a 2:1 home victory serving as the set-piece breakthrough contingency.

goals.comment: Expect a tightly managed 2-goal primary distribution, expanding to 3 goals only if Horsens's chronic road defensive errors force an open second half.

bqc.comment: A measured, low-tempo opening half between fatigued hosts and cautious visitors leads to a level break before second-half tactical separation.
